title: Finite free exact sequences of arbitrary prescribed length
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], M a finite R-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and k a natural number. There exists an exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] 0 → K → F_{k-1} → ⋯ → F_0 → M → 0 with precisely k finite free terms [def-weil-pbc-free-module]; no condition is imposed on the depth of K. For k = 0 the sequence is 0 → M → M → 0 with identity middle map. The composable-arrow encoding has k+3 arrows, zero endpoint objects, and its penultimate object linearly equivalent to M, in universe max(u,v).

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00LP (lemma-resolution-by-finite-free), part (2), finite truncations of the successive-surjection construction; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00LP

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_free_resolution_data
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ S : ComposableArrows (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (k + 3),
      S.Exact ∧ IsZero (S.obj' 0) ∧ IsZero (S.obj' (k + 3)) ∧
      Nonempty ((S.obj' (k + 2)) ≃ₗ[R] M) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k,
        Module.Free R (S.obj' (i.val + 2) (by omega)) ∧
        Module.Finite R (S.obj' (i.val + 2) (by omega)))
